effect_size.excerpt: Specifically, increased intake of red meat (AOR = 5.248), and alcohol (AOR = 2.189) were associated with a high PCa incidence while increased intake of soya (AOR = 0.248), coffee (AOR = 0.603), tomato (AOR = 0.188), and not being married (AOR = 0.147) were associated with lower incidence of PCa in the Tanzanian urban population.
